encounters.title: The Shifting Labyrinth
encounters.description: The fairy-realm labyrinth twists impossibly around your ship. Corridors of light bend and fold. Deep within, your sensors detect a life sign — calm, steady, as if whoever is in there isn't lost at all. Star charts are etched into the walls in an elegant paw.

dialogue_steps.speaker: aristotle
dialogue_steps.text: The labyrinth is shifting again. Corridors are folding in on themselves — our navigation systems can't keep up.

dialogue_steps.speaker: aristotle
dialogue_steps.text: But there's a life sign at the centre. Steady heartbeat, no distress. Whoever's in there is... comfortable.

choices.text: Follow the star charts etched on the walls deeper into the labyrinth.

outcome.description: The charts lead you through corridors that shouldn't exist. At the centre, a graceful cat sits cross-legged, sketching a new constellation.

choices.text: Broadcast a rescue signal into the labyrinth.

outcome.description: Your signal echoes and warps through the impossible corridors. Then a reply — not distressed, but amused.

dialogue_steps.speaker: aristotle
dialogue_steps.text: These charts on the walls... they're not just decorative. They're directions. Each one leads deeper.

dialogue_steps.speaker: aristotle
dialogue_steps.text: The style is beautiful. Whoever drew these understands the labyrinth on a level I've never seen.

dialogue_steps.speaker: silky
dialogue_steps.text: That's because most people try to solve the labyrinth. I simply asked it where it wanted to go.

dialogue_steps.speaker: aristotle
dialogue_steps.text: Who — where did you come from? I didn't see you approach.

dialogue_steps.speaker: silky
dialogue_steps.text: I've been here the whole time, Aristotle. I drew those charts for you. You followed them beautifully, by the way.

dialogue_steps.speaker: aristotle
dialogue_steps.text: You know my name?

dialogue_steps.speaker: silky
dialogue_steps.text: I know a great many things. Your name. Your heading. The exact number of whisper crystals in your hold. The labyrinth speaks to those who listen.

dialogue_steps.speaker: aristotle
dialogue_steps.text: That's... either impressive or deeply unsettling.

dialogue_steps.speaker: silky
dialogue_steps.text: Why not both? My name is Silky. And you're right on schedule.

dialogue_steps.speaker: silky
dialogue_steps.text: No need to shout, Captain. I'm right here.

dialogue_steps.speaker: aristotle
dialogue_steps.text: I — what? Where did you come from? We were broadcasting a rescue signal.

dialogue_steps.speaker: silky
dialogue_steps.text: Yes, I heard. Very loud. The labyrinth heard it too — it found the whole thing rather amusing.

dialogue_steps.speaker: aristotle
dialogue_steps.text: The labyrinth found it amusing. Right. And you are?

dialogue_steps.speaker: silky
dialogue_steps.text: My name is Silky. And I wasn't in need of rescue, Aristotle. I was waiting for you.

dialogue_steps.speaker: aristotle
dialogue_steps.text: You know my name. How long have you been in here?

dialogue_steps.speaker: silky
dialogue_steps.text: Long enough to chart every route in and out. Long enough to learn the labyrinth's moods. Long enough to know that your ship would pass through this sector on the seventeenth day of the new cycle.

dialogue_steps.speaker: aristotle
dialogue_steps.text: I didn't even know I'd be here until yesterday.

dialogue_steps.speaker: silky
dialogue_steps.text: And yet here you are. I was beginning to think you'd never arrive.

encounters.title: Silky Joins the Crew
encounters.description: Silky sits in the ship's observation lounge, surrounded by rolled star charts. She watches the labyrinth recede through the viewport with an expression that might be fondness.

dialogue_steps.speaker: aristotle
dialogue_steps.text: You said you were waiting for me. I'd like an explanation for that, if you don't mind.

dialogue_steps.speaker: silky
dialogue_steps.text: The stars tell stories, Aristotle. Most people see dots of light. I see routes, currents, the way the universe breathes.

dialogue_steps.speaker: silky
dialogue_steps.text: Your story has been written in the star charts for months. A cat captain, carrying whisper crystals, threading the needle between factions that want to control the only fuel in the multiverse.

dialogue_steps.speaker: aristotle
dialogue_steps.text: And you decided to wait in a labyrinth for me to show up? That's a lot of faith in star charts.

dialogue_steps.speaker: silky
dialogue_steps.text: Faith has nothing to do with it. Mathematics. Pattern recognition. And a good sense of timing.

dialogue_steps.speaker: silky
dialogue_steps.text: I've mapped routes that no one else knows. Paths between realms. Shortcuts through nebulae. Ways to slip past any blockade the League or the Lions could build.

dialogue_steps.speaker: aristotle
dialogue_steps.text: That kind of knowledge is dangerous to carry alone.

dialogue_steps.speaker: silky
dialogue_steps.text: Precisely why I've been waiting for the right ship. One with a captain who navigates by instinct rather than greed. Yours will do nicely.

dialogue_steps.speaker: aristotle
dialogue_steps.text: That almost sounded like a compliment buried under three layers of mysticism.

choices.text: The navigation console is yours. Show us the hidden routes.

outcome.description: Silky's eyes sparkle as she takes her place at the navigator's station. Within minutes, the ship's charts bloom with routes no one has ever seen.

dialogue_steps.speaker: silky
dialogue_steps.text: Navigator Silky, at your service. Though I should warn you — I don't navigate so much as... converse with the space between stars.

dialogue_steps.speaker: aristotle
dialogue_steps.text: As long as we end up where we need to be, you can converse with whatever you like.

dialogue_steps.speaker: silky
dialogue_steps.text: Oh, we'll end up where we need to be. Whether that's where you think you want to go is another matter entirely.

dialogue_steps.speaker: silky
dialogue_steps.text: Now then. Let me show you how the universe really looks.

dialogue_steps.speaker: aristotle
dialogue_steps.text: Why do I get the feeling my life just got significantly more complicated?

dialogue_steps.speaker: silky
dialogue_steps.text: Because it did. But in the most interesting way possible.
